title: Days and dates
summary: Sequence days and months and begin recording time.
subject: maths

difficultyRamp.within: Q1 crosses a week boundary. Q2 orders days from a given start. Q3 finds preceding months. Q4 reads a named seconds record. Q5 reverses yesterday to find today. Q6 orders months across a year boundary. Q7 spots a five-day-week error. Q8 matches names and measured records. Q9 compares minute, hour, day and week. Q10 moves two months across a year boundary.
difficultyRamp.versus: Easy builds daily language, weekdays and recognition of month names. Medium sequences weekdays and months across boundaries and chooses units for recording time. Hard adds reverse reasoning from yesterday, spots incomplete weeks, matches named measured records and moves two months across a year boundary. No clock reading, month-length facts or conversions are required.
